summary.prose: Building this Story is a straight-line, five-task sequence: export/add two small pure helpers, write one new self-contained panel file, widen three small existing interfaces plus their host-side implementation, wire the panel into the extension's existing construction site, then round out tests. Nothing here touches the native Settings UI or the existing QuickPick wizard — this is a purely additive build.

tasks.title: Export currentTier and add the tierStatus helper
tasks.summary: In model-tier-picker.ts: change currentTier from a private function to an exported one (no signature/behavior change), and add a new exported pure function tierStatus(defs, raw, tier, coreFloor): TierStatus that classifies ok/not-supported/not-listed/floor-raised, generalizing pickModel's existing inline marker logic and the floor-vs-coreFloor rank comparison.
acceptanceChecks: currentTier is exported from model-tier-picker.ts with an unchanged signature and behavior; runSetModelTier's existing QuickPick flow still passes its existing tests unmodified

tierStatus returns 'not-supported' for a configured model unresolved in a host-set (closed-list) family, 'not-listed' for the same in an open vendor family or an unresolved runner, 'floor-raised' when the tier ranks below coreFloor, and 'ok' otherwise

tests.name: model-tier-picker.test.ts: currentTier remains exported with unchanged resolution behavior
model-tier-picker.test.ts: tierStatus classifies ok/not-supported/not-listed/floor-raised across a host-set family, an open vendor family, an unresolvable runner, and all three coreFloor values

tasks.title: Create model-tiers.ts: renderer, write DTO, and write handler
tasks.summary: New file vscode-plugin/src/panels/model-tiers.ts exporting: ModelTiersRendererDeps, renderModelTiers(deps): ModelTiersRenderer (one card per tier via currentTier+tierStatus, plus the Core-floor footer select; no 'Check an unlisted model…' link per the documented non-goal); the ModelTiersWrite discriminated union ({kind:'tierField',...}|{kind:'coreFloor',...}); ModelTiersWriteHandlerDeps; and createModelTiersWriteHandler(deps): (write) => void, which calls deps.refresh() when config.write resolves (ok or refused) and does not call it when config.write rejects.
acceptanceChecks: renderModelTiers's output embeds one labelled card per tier (core/mid/cheap) with runner/model/effort dropdowns, a cloud/local hosting badge, inline tierStatus text, and the Core-floor select bound to the current coreFloor value

createModelTiersWriteHandler maps a {kind:'tierField'} write to insrc.models.tiers.<tier>.<field> and a {kind:'coreFloor'} write to insrc.models.coreFloor, calling deps.refresh() on both an accepted and a refused resolution but not on a rejection

tests.name: model-tiers.test.ts: renderModelTiers renders one labelled card per tier (core/mid/cheap), not a flat field list
model-tiers.test.ts: renderModelTiers renders the panel-foot Core-floor <select> bound to the current insrc.models.coreFloor value
model-tiers.test.ts: createModelTiersWriteHandler maps both ModelTiersWrite kinds to the right config.write key and calls refresh() only when config.write resolves (not when it rejects)

tasks.title: Widen panel-host types and wire openModelTiers + the status-bar menu entry
tasks.summary: In types.ts: add openModelTiers(): void to WebviewPanelHost; add modelTiersRenderer?/onModelTiersWrite? to WebviewPanelHostDeps; widen MenuItem.action to include 'modelTiers'. In webview-host.ts: implement openModelTiers (opens/reveals the singleton panel; placeholder body when no renderer is injected, exactly as openRepoConfiguration does today), a handleModelTiersMessage validating the incoming postMessage shape for both ModelTiersWrite kinds before forwarding to onModelTiersWrite, and add a 'Model Tiers' entry to the status-bar menu array alongside 'Repo Configuration'.
acceptanceChecks: openModelTiers always opens/reveals the panel (never a no-op) and shows the placeholder body when modelTiersRenderer is unset
a malformed/unrecognized postMessage is silently dropped and never reaches onModelTiersWrite, matching the existing fallback behavior for an unrecognized message
the status-bar menu offers 'Model Tiers' alongside the existing 'Repo Configuration' entry

tests.name: webview-host.test.ts: openModelTiers always opens/reveals the panel and falls back to a placeholder body when modelTiersRenderer is unset
webview-host.test.ts: the status-bar MenuItem list carries the new 'Model Tiers' entry alongside 'Repo Configuration'
webview-host.test.ts: a malformed postMessage of either ModelTiersWrite kind is silently dropped and never reaches onModelTiersWrite

tasks.title: Wire the Model Tiers panel into extension.ts
tasks.summary: In extension.ts's existing panelHost construction, add modelTiersRenderer: renderModelTiers({...}) and onModelTiersWrite: createModelTiersWriteHandler({...refresh: () => panelHost.openModelTiers()}), and register a new 'insrc.status.modelTiers' command calling panelHost.openModelTiers(), copying the existing repoConfig wiring pattern verbatim.
acceptanceChecks: invoking the new command (or the status-bar menu entry) opens the Model Tiers panel showing live data from the daemon's current model definitions and insrc.models.* config
a write made in the panel round-trips through config.write and is reflected back after refresh, exactly as the Repo Configuration panel's existing write path already does

tests.name: model-tiers.test.ts / webview-host.test.ts: createModelTiersWriteHandler's refresh callback, wired exactly as in extension.ts's panelHost construction, invokes openModelTiers after a resolved write

tasks.title: Write unit tests for the new data layer, renderer/handler, and host wiring
tasks.summary: Add/extend tests per the approved test strategy: model-tier-picker.test.ts for currentTier (export, unchanged behavior) and tierStatus (all four status branches across host-set/open/unresolved families and all three coreFloor values); model-tiers.test.ts for renderModelTiers (card content, hosting badges, Core-floor select) and createModelTiersWriteHandler (both write kinds, refresh-on-resolve-not-on-reject); webview-host.test.ts for openModelTiers (no-op-never, placeholder fallback) and the new menu entry.
acceptanceChecks: every acceptanceMapping proving test named in the LLD's ac1 and ac2 rows exists and passes
a rejecting config.write does not call refresh, while a resolved-but-refused config.write does call refresh
a malformed postMessage of either ModelTiersWrite kind ('tierField' or 'coreFloor') is silently dropped and never reaches onModelTiersWrite
a removed/unresolvable configured model renders the not-supported or not-listed styling per tierStatus's classification
three identically-configured tiers render as three independent, separately-editable cards
two rapid writes to the same control are each forwarded and handled independently in arrival order
the full vscode-plugin test suite (npx tsx --test, default node, per project convention) passes with these additions and no existing test is modified to pass artificially

tests.name: model-tiers.test.ts: a tier card shows a cloud/local hosting badge matching its resolved family's hosting
model-tiers.test.ts: a tier whose configured model is not in the catalog renders the not-supported note inline, matching mocks/model-tiers-grouped.html
model-tier-picker.test.ts: tierStatus returns floor-raised for every tier ranked below coreFloor, and omits it when coreFloor is 'cheap'
model-tiers.test.ts: createModelTiersWriteHandler maps a { kind: 'coreFloor', value } write to the insrc.models.coreFloor key
